description: Estimate what a Alaska Airlines ticket earns (miles or points, and status credit where it applies), using cwsi.net's calculator and the airline's published rules. Unofficial.

card.description: Paying with an Atmos Rewards card. none = No; AS = Ascent (+3 per $1); SU = Summit (+3 per $1); BU = Business (+3 per $1).

creditClass.description: The booking class letter on the ticket, for creditTo (required with creditTo). Ignored without creditTo.

creditFlights.description: The flights for creditTo: one entry per one-way flight, in order, with its great-circle miles (calculate_flight_distance gives them) and optionally from/to airport codes. Defaults to segs when they carry miles.

from.description: The departure airport's code; labels the breakdown.

miles.description: Great-circle distance of this flight in miles.

to.description: The arrival airport's code; labels the breakdown.

creditStatus.description: Your status in the creditTo program, by its name as listed under creditTo. Defaults to the base level. Ignored without creditTo.

creditTo.description: Credit the flights to a partner program instead of Alaska Airlines's own: american = American AAdvantage (creditStatus one of: AAdvantage member, AAdvantage Gold, AAdvantage Platinum, AAdvantage Platinum Pro, AAdvantage Executive Platinum); ba-club = British Airways Club (creditStatus one of: Blue, Bronze, Silver, Gold). Earns by each flight's distance and the booking class at the program's published partner rates; leave creditTo out for the airline's own program. Give the booking class letter as creditClass. Give the flights as creditFlights (one entry per flight with its great-circle miles). No price is needed with creditTo.

fare.description: Fare. 200 = First, full fare (J); 175 = First (C); 150a = First, discount (D, I); 150b = Main, full fare (Y, B); 125 = Main (H, K); 100 = Main, discount (M, L, V, S, N, Q, O, G); 0 = Saver (X). Only applies to some choices of the other fields; ignored otherwise.

kind.description: Fare type. paid = Paid fare (Main, Premium, First); basic = Basic or Saver (earns 0). Only applies to some choices of the other fields; ignored otherwise.

legacy.description: Saver booked early or flown soon. 1 = Yes (30%); 0 = No (earns 0). Saver earns 30% when booked before Jun 11, 2026, or flown through Jul 31, 2026. Otherwise it earns 0. Only applies to some choices of the other fields; ignored otherwise.

method.description: Your earning method. dist = Distance (1 per mile); price = Price paid (5 per $1); seg = Segments (500 per segment). Only applies to some choices of the other fields; ignored otherwise.

miles.description: Miles flown. The flight distance in miles. Only applies to some choices of the other fields; ignored otherwise.

price.description: Price paid (before taxes and fees) in US dollars. Needed for your card, or for the price method from 2027. Required unless creditTo is given.

segs.description: Segments. Each flight (segment) earns 500 points. Only applies to some choices of the other fields; ignored otherwise.

status.description: Your Atmos status. none = Member (No status); SV = Silver (+25%); GD = Gold (+50%); PT = Platinum (+100%); TT = Titanium (+150%).

when.description: When do you fly?. 2026 = Through Dec 31, 2026; 2027 = From Jan 1, 2027. Members choose a method from Oct 1, 2026; it applies to flights from Jan 1, 2027.

name: calculate_alaska_miles
title: Alaska Atmos Rewards Calculator
